title: Log: promote FIPS gate failures outside ioctl_init from pr_debug to pr_err_ratelimited
description: fd.c: FIPS gate failures in write() (line 409-415), read() (570-575), set_iv() (840-844), gen_iv() (889-893), finalize() (1375-1380), and reset() (1448-1453) use pr_debug. In production kernels without CONFIG_DYNAMIC_DEBUG these are compiled out. Callers receive -EACCES with zero kernel log evidence. Only ioctl_init (line 759) uses pr_err. Fix: change all six pr_debug FIPS gate failure sites to pr_err_ratelimited to match ioctl_init behavior. Each already includes algo and provider name in the format — just change the log level.
